Freego X1 SE Class 2/3 All-Terrain Electric Bike

The Freego X1 SE is a versatile all-terrain electric bike designed for everyday commuting, recreational riding, and weekend adventures. Powered by a 750W nominal motor and a 60V 25Ah battery, it combines practical performance with pedal assist, throttle control, full suspension, and 4-piston hydraulic brakes for a confident and comfortable ride.

Why Riders Choose the Freego X1 SE

The X1 SE brings together the familiar control of an e-bike with the rugged design of an all-terrain machine. Its 750W motor delivers practical power for everyday riding, while the pedals give riders the flexibility to choose between throttle and pedal-assisted riding.

With throttle assist up to 20 MPH and pedal assist up to 28 MPH, the X1 SE is designed to support Class 2 and Class 3 riding configurations. Full suspension, motorcycle-grade tires, 4-piston hydraulic brakes, turn signals, and a rear brake light add comfort, control, and everyday practicality whether you're commuting through the city or exploring beyond paved roads.

Key Specifications

Motor Power 750W (Nominal)

Class 2 Speed Up to 20 MPH with Throttle

Class 3 Speed Up to 28 MPH with Pedal Assist

Battery 60V, 25Ah (1620Wh)

Riding Range 20–50 Mi

Throttle Type Full-Twist Throttle

Controller Brushless Motor Controller, 35A / 180A

Frame High-Strength Steel

Display LCD Display

Max Load 264 lb (120 kg)

Net Weight 117 lb (53 kg)

Charging Time 6–8 H

Transmission Single Speed

Brake System 4-Piston Hydraulic Brakes

Suspension Full Suspension

Turn Signals Yes

Brake Light Yes

Wheel Type & Size Spoke Wheels, Front/Rear 17 × 1.4 Alloy Rims

Tire Type & Size 70/100–17 (2.75 × 17 in) Tubed, Pneumatic Motorcycle-Grade Tires, Puncture-Resistant

Package Size 61” × 11.4” × 34.2” (155 × 29 × 87 cm)

Suggested Rider Height 5’3”–6’1” (160–185 cm)

Range Note

Actual riding range may vary depending on rider weight, speed, terrain, temperature, wind, tire pressure, payload, and riding mode.

FAQ

Is the Freego X1 SE a Class 2 or Class 3 e-bike?
The X1 SE supports throttle assist up to 20 MPH and pedal assist up to 28 MPH, allowing it to support Class 2 and Class 3 riding configurations. Always check your local e-bike regulations before riding on public roads or bike paths.

What is the Freego X1 SE motor power?
The Freego X1 SE is powered by a 750W nominal motor, providing practical performance for commuting, recreational riding, and varied terrain.

How fast can the Freego X1 SE go?
The X1 SE provides throttle assist up to 20 MPH and pedal assist up to 28 MPH.

What battery and range does the Freego X1 SE have?
It features a 60V 25Ah (1620Wh) battery with a listed riding range of 20–50 miles, depending on riding conditions.

Is the Freego X1 SE suitable for commuting?
Yes. The X1 SE combines a 750W motor, pedal assist, hydraulic brakes, full suspension, turn signals, and a rear brake light, making it a practical option for everyday commuting and recreational riding.
